title.narrative: Consultations are held with the advisory council.
Number of consultations with the advisory council

target.value: At least 5 consultation with advisory council members.

actual.value: -More than 10 members of the Advisory Council were consulted on various aspects of strategy and drafting of the Guidelines.

title.narrative: An interinstitutional structure is created to lead the initiative
An interinstitutional structure is created to lead the initiative.

target.value: The structure is set up comprised of 3 institutions in the “coordination group”; 15 members in the “steering committee”; 11 members in the “drafting group”; At least 40 members in the “advisory council”.

actual.value: A Steering Committee of 15 technical experts from varied disciplines. backgrounds and origins has been created . -A drafting group of 11 experts has been created divided in two groups: investigative interviewing; procedural safeguards . -An Advisory Council of 49 members

title.narrative: Advocacy activities are carried out with States
Number of advocacy activities with States

actual.value: Advocacy activities took place in Thailand. Mexico. Tunisia and Brazil. Bilateral meetings to present the initiative and discuss endorsement strategies with Morocco. Ghana. Chile. Indonesia. Germany. France. Sweden. Australia. New Zealand.

title.narrative: The set of guidelines for investigative interviewing is supported by regional and international bodies
Number of briefings and advocacy activities with key actors, including regional and international bodies, civil society, practitioners’ networks

actual.value: Briefings and advocacy activities were provided to: - Committee against torture (CAT) - Subcommittee on prevention of torture (SPT) - Special Rapporteur on torture. Independent Expert on protection against violence and discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity. Special Rapporteur on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities - European Committee for the Prevention of Torture (CPT) - OSCE/ODIHR

title.narrative: Meetings are organized between the different constituent bodies
Number of meetings organized between the different constituent bodies

target.value: 3 meetings (2 of the Steering Committee and 1 of the drafting group)

actual.value: First meeting of the Steering Committee in Rio to adopt the working plan for 2018-2019 and formally appoint experts to serve on the Drafting Group and Advisory Council in May. First meeting of the Drafting Group to draw up the main lines of the protocol in September in Geneva. Second meeting of the Steering Committee in December in Tunis to review. compile and revise the first draft of the Guidelines as well as drawing-up revised/additional instructions and guidelines for drafters.

title.narrative: Advocacy activities have led to the endorsement of a set of guidelines on investigative interviewing and safeguards

target.value: Advocacy activities undertaken have led to the endorsement of a set of guidelines on investigative interviewing and safeguards.
